title: Magnetic moments of strange hidden-bottom pentaquarks and the role of spin flavor correlations
summary: We investigate the magnetic moments of strange hidden-bottom pentaquark states within the constituent quark model, considering both molecular and compact configurations. The system with quark content $qqqb\bar{b}$ ($q=u,d,s$) is analyzed in three configurations: a baryon-meson molecular form $(\bar b q_1)(b q_2 q_3)$, a diquark-diquark-antiquark structure $(b q_1)(q_2 q_3)\bar b$, and a diquark-triquark configuration $(b q_1)(\bar b q_2 q_3)$.
